payload.words: hyp names no event kind it does not act on: budget.reset and result.retract are gone, and the budget restarts at the latest example-changing place or the latest unselect.

lines.text: hyp spec lists no event kind budget.reset or result.retract, no guard Own Result and no code no-result-to-retract.
hyp spec says the budget's boundary is the latest example-changing place or the latest unselect, else the Goal's start, and does not say that a retracted Result counts.
hyp status of a store that holds a budget.reset or a result.retract event lists each one under not read at replay: as an unknown event type.
After an unselect, or after a place that changes an example, hyp status G shows runs: 0 of 3 used.

why: Goal B of #430: the spec names budget.reset and result.retract, which no command writes and replay does not act on (F-N2NRZV); owner: remove both, and the boundary is the latest example-changing place or the latest unselect (Q2 a).
